title: Assets and handover

sections.title: Assigning an asset to an employee

html:
Menu: HR → Assets and handover

The Assets and handover module serves to keep records of the company assets assigned to the employees (laptop, phone, key, card and so on) and to document the handover.

10.12.1Assigning an asset to an employee

  1. Menu: HR → Assets and handover → New assignment, or from the employee's profile.

  2. Select the asset type and the unique identifier (for example the laptop serial number).

  3. Enter the date of the handover.

  4. Upload the handover document (if there is one).

  5. Save.

Field Type Mandatory? Explanation / tips
Asset type Enum Yes Laptop / phone / key / access card / other.
Identifier / serial number Text No Unique asset identification.
Employee User Yes Which employee it is assigned to.
Date of handover Date Yes When the employee received it.
Date of return Date No To be filled in at termination.
Document File No Handover certificate.

10.12.2Taking assets back at termination

The termination process (see chapter 10.13) automatically lists the assets assigned to the given employee. For every asset, the date and the condition of the return have to be recorded.
